data.rationale: HDFC Bank forecast reflects post-merger normalization with gradual CASA ratio recovery from current 34% toward historic 40%+ levels by FY30E. Loan growth normalizing at 12-14% range as integration effects stabilize. NIM expected to expand 15-20 bps over 5 years driven by CASA improvement and liability optimization. Asset quality remains strong with credit costs trending lower from current 45 bps to 35 bps reflecting excellent underwriting. Cost-to-income improving gradually through operating leverage and digital initiatives. ROA expanding from 1.92% to 2.20% and ROE from 13.9% to 16.0% as profitability metrics normalize post-merger. Strong capital base with CAR above regulatory requirements allows sustainable growth without dilution.
